shapeSummary: Single round aluminum hub, 12 mm diameter and 4.5 mm thick, with its axis along Y and its bottom face at Y=0. It has a 3 mm central through bore, four 2.2 mm blind mounting holes 3 mm deep on a square pattern at ±3.1 mm on the top face, and one 2.3 mm radial set-screw hole along +Z at mid-height that meets the bore. The set screws and Allen wrench from the 2-pack are not modeled.
warnings: The listing gives no dimensions except the 3 mm shaft, so the outer diameter, thickness, hole sizes, hole spacing and set-screw position are estimates scaled from the photos.
The mounting holes are modeled as plain 2.2 mm blind holes 3 mm deep. Their real depth is not visible and the #2-56 threads are not modeled.
The set-screw hole is modeled as a plain 2.3 mm hole at mid-height on the +Z side, with no thread. Its exact position and direction are uncertain.
Only one hub is modeled. The second hub, the set screws and the Allen wrench are omitted.
cadquery:
part = cq.Workplane('XZ').circle(6).extrude(-4.5)
bore = cq.Workplane('XZ').circle(1.5).extrude(-4.5)
mount = (cq.Workplane('XZ', origin=(0, 4.5, 0))
         .pushPoints([(3.1, 3.1), (-3.1, 3.1), (3.1, -3.1), (-3.1, -3.1)])
         .circle(1.1).extrude(3))
set_screw = cq.Workplane('XY').center(0, 2.25).circle(1.15).extrude(7)
part = part.cut(bore).cut(mount).cut(set_screw)
